task_definition.title: Attention Rail T2: title convention doc in spawn SKILL.md + titles at factory-init spawn steps
task_definition.description:
Two doc edits establishing the terminal-title convention:

1. skills/spawn/SKILL.md — make the `terminal_title` argument effectively required for programmatic callers, and document the convention `<role>:<project>#<task-id> <short-slug>`. Update the Arguments and Invocation sections accordingly. Do NOT alter the positional contract or spawn-claude.sh behaviour — this is documentation of the existing title plumbing.
2. skills/factory-init/SKILL.md — the spawn steps (positional form `<cwd> <skip_perms> '<title>' '<prompt>'`) currently pass ad-hoc or empty titles; make each spawn pass a convention-shaped title.

Pure doc edits over already-present title plumbing.
